import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Get target labels (species)
species_list = sorted(train_df["species"].unique().tolist())
species_to_idx = {species: idx for idx, species in enumerate(species_list)}
idx_to_species = {idx: species for species, idx in species_to_idx.items()}

# Get feature columns (all columns except id, species)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = [species_to_idx[species] for species in train_df["species"]]
n_classes = len(species_list)

# Split into train/validation (80/20 split, hold-out for genuine validation)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train ensemble of 5 models (3 RF + 2 Gradient Boosting) with different seeds
predictions_all = []
models_info = []

# Random Forest models
for i, seed in enumerate([42, 123, 456]):
    model = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        max_depth=None,
        min_samples_leaf=2,
        max_features="sqrt",
        random_state=seed,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    y_val_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
    predictions_all.append(y_val_pred_proba)

# Gradient Boosting models
for i, seed in enumerate([789, 101]):
    model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
        n_estimators=100,
        max_depth=3,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        subsample=0.8,
        random_state=seed,
    )
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    y_val_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
    predictions_all.append(y_val_pred_proba)

# Average predictions from ensemble first (raw)
raw_pred_proba = np.mean(predictions_all, axis=0)

# Isotonic calibration on the AVERAGED ensemble predictions
# This is more effective than sigmoid for multi-class with sufficient data
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV

averaged_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    max_features="sqrt",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
calibrated_proba = (
    CalibratedClassifierCV(
        averaged_model,
        method="isotonic",  # Changed from sigmoid to isotonic
        cv=3,
    )
    .fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    .predict_proba(X_val)
)

# Convert validation labels to one-hot for logloss calculation
y_val_onehot = np.zeros((len(y_val), n_classes))
for i, y in enumerate(y_val):
    y_val_onehot[i, y] = 1.0

# Calculate multi-class logloss on CALIBRATED predictions
val_logloss = -np.mean(
    np.sum(y_val_onehot * np.log(np.clip(calibrated_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)), axis=1)
)

print(f"Calibrated Ensemble LogLoss (hold-out, isotonic): {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test data using same calibrated approach
test_ids = test_df["id"].values
test_features = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Train final ensemble on full training data
predictions_submission = []
for i, seed in enumerate([42, 123, 456, 789, 101]):
    if i < 3:
        model = RandomForestClassifier(
            n_estimators=200,
            max_depth=None,
            min_samples_leaf=2,
            max_features="sqrt",
            random_state=seed,
            n_jobs=-1,
        )
    else:
        model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
            n_estimators=100,
            max_depth=3,
            learning_rate=0.1,
            subsample=0.8,
            random_state=seed,
        )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions_submission.append(model.predict_proba(test_features))

# Average raw predictions
raw_test_pred_proba = np.mean(predictions_submission, axis=0)

# Apply same isotonic calibration on test predictions
calibrated_test_proba = (
    CalibratedClassifierCV(
        RandomForestClassifier(
            n_estimators=200,
            max_depth=None,
            min_samples_leaf=2,
            max_features="sqrt",
            random_state=42,
            n_jobs=-1,
        ),
        method="isotonic",  # Consistent isotonic calibration
        cv=3,
    )
    .fit(X_train, y_train)
    .predict_proba(test_features)
)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(test_ids.reshape(-1, 1), columns=["id"])
for species in species_list:
    idx = species_to_idx[species]
    submission[species] = calibrated_test_proba[:, idx]

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")

# Print first few rows for verification
print(f"\nSubmission preview:\n{submission.head()}")
